title: onobrychis laxiflora var. schugnanica
intro: Onobrychis laxiflora var. schugnanica, commonly known as Schugnan pea, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating symptoms of inflammation, pain, and fever, as well as providing antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Schugnan pea are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties, which can help in the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Schugnan pea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
